title: How to Activate UAN 2026: EPF Face Auth, KYC, Balance
meta_description: Activate your EPF UAN (Universal Account Number) online in 5 minutes. Step-by-step guide for PF balance check, withdrawal, and transfer.

hero.one_liner: Your UAN (Universal Account Number) is the master key to all EPF services - activate it in 5 minutes to check balance, withdraw PF, and transfer funds

sections.heading: What a UAN Is and Why You Activate It
content: The full form of UAN is Universal Account Number. It is a 12-digit number EPFO gives every EPF member.
UAN stands for Universal Account Number, a 12-digit permanent ID issued by EPFO to every EPF member. Unlike your Member ID, which changes with each job, the UAN stays the same for life.
It is your single login for all EPFO online services, and it links every PF account across all your employers. Even if you change ten jobs, the same UAN follows you.

Without an activated UAN you cannot check your PF balance online, transfer PF between jobs, or file a withdrawal claim. Your employer generates the UAN when you join, but you must activate it yourself.
The UAN system replaced the old paper-based transfer process, where moving PF between jobs meant office visits and months of waiting.
Now the same number carries your entire PF history, so management stays simple no matter how often you switch employers.
By law, every employer registered with EPFO must allot a UAN to a new employee within a few days of joining. If yours has not, that is a compliance failure you can raise.
A UAN that was generated but never linked to an active job simply stays dormant with a zero balance until you join an EPFO-covered employer.

sections.heading: UAN Activation: Key Numbers

sections.title: New: UAN Activation Now Uses Aadhaar Face Authentication
sections.content:
Since 1 August 2025, EPFO activates new UANs through Aadhaar-based Face Authentication on the UMANG app, not the old OTP form. This cuts fraud and works even if your Aadhaar mobile is not handy.

The older portal and OTP method still works for many members, so this guide covers both. Use the UMANG face-auth route if the portal OTP fails.

sections.heading: Where to Find Your UAN Number
content: Your UAN is printed on your salary slip in the UAN field, and on the PF passbook your company issues. It is also on the EPF certificate from your HR.
If you cannot find it, ask your HR or payroll team, since by law they must give you a UAN within days of joining. You can also use the Know Your UAN service on the EPFO portal.
If your first job was in one state and you later move, the UAN does not change, since it is national and works across all EPFO offices.
Keep your UAN noted somewhere safe, because you will need it for every balance check, transfer, and withdrawal for the rest of your working life.

sections.heading: Activate UAN via UMANG Face Authentication

steps.title: Install UMANG
steps.desc: Download the UMANG app and register with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

steps.title: Open UAN service
steps.desc: Search EPFO, then choose UAN Activation through Face Auth.

steps.title: Face scan
steps.desc: Enter your UAN and Aadhaar, then complete the Aadhaar face scan when prompted.

steps.title: Set password
steps.desc: Once verified, set your password. Activation usually completes within a few hours.

sections.heading: Activate UAN on the EPFO Portal (Alternate)
content: If you prefer the web portal, go to unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in and click Activate UAN. Enter your UAN, Aadhaar, date of birth, and Aadhaar-linked mobile.
Click Get Authorization PIN, enter the OTP, and set an 8-character password. Log in with your UAN and new password, then your dashboard opens.

sections.heading: Common Activation Problems and Fixes
content: The top reason activation fails is a mobile mismatch, where your activation number does not match your Aadhaar-linked number. Update your Aadhaar mobile first, then retry.
A name or DOB mismatch is the next most common, for example HR entered R Kumar but Aadhaar says Rajesh Kumar. Ask your employer to correct it in the EPFO portal, then try again.
If your UAN is already activated from a past job, do not re-activate. Use Forgot Password at the login page to reset it instead.
If a new employer mistakenly generated a second UAN, do not leave it, since it splits your PF balance across two numbers.
Log in with your primary UAN and use One Member One EPF Account to merge the duplicate, or ask EPFO to consolidate them.

sections.heading: Activation Errors and How to Solve Them
rows: Your employer hasn't uploaded your UAN to EPFO portal yet, or UAN number is wrong
Double-check UAN from salary slip. Ask HR if they've filed your Establishment Registration. If yes, wait 3-5 days and try again.
Your name on Aadhaar and in EPFO database are different (spelling, spaces, etc.)
Correct your name on Aadhaar first (aadhar.uidai.gov.in, ₹50 fee, 10-30 days). Or ask HR to update name in EPFO system and try again.
You received no OTP on your phone
Update your mobile number on Aadhaar at aadhar.uidai.gov.in or any UIDAI center. Takes 30 minutes. Then retry activation.
DOB on Aadhaar and EPFO system don't match
Confirm DOB - if wrong on Aadhaar, correct it. If wrong in EPFO, ask HR to correct it via Establishment Portal.
You can't login to your activated account
Go to unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in → 'Forgot Password' → Enter UAN → OTP on mobile → set new password. Process takes 2 minutes.
You're trying to activate same UAN twice
Your UAN is already activated (probably from a previous job change). Just login with UAN + password. If you forgot password, use 'Forgot Password' option.

sections.heading: UAN KYC: Linking Aadhaar, PAN, and Bank
content: Without approved KYC, Aadhaar plus PAN plus a bank account linked to your UAN, you cannot file any online claim. This is the most common reason people cannot withdraw PF.
Log in, go to Manage then KYC, and enter your Aadhaar, PAN, and bank account with IFSC. Your employer must approve the KYC from their portal, after which EPFO verifies it.
Total processing is about 2 to 7 days. Make sure the linked bank account is your own personal savings account, not a joint or closed one.
If your KYC is rejected, the usual reasons are an Aadhaar name mismatch, a wrong PAN, or bank details that do not match. Fix the specific field and resubmit.
If your employer does not approve the KYC within about a week, escalate to HR and ask them to log in to the employer portal and clear it.

sections.title: EPF Interest for FY 2025-26
sections.desc:
EPF pays 8.25% a year for 2025-26, one of the highest risk-free returns in India, held steady for the third year running. Interest is calculated monthly and credited annually.

A combined Rs 5,000 a month for 30 years at 8.25% grows to roughly Rs 78 lakh, with about Rs 60 lakh of that being interest. That is the quiet power of EPF.

sections.heading: What You Can Do After Activation
content: Check your EPF balance through Passbook to see monthly employee and employer contributions, interest, and the total. You can also check by SMS or a missed call to 011-22901406.
Transfer PF when you change jobs through Online Services, One Member One EPF Account. This is the single most valuable UAN feature, processed in about 15 to 20 days.
Download your UAN card and passbook anytime, and update your bank details before filing any withdrawal.
If you changed jobs recently, check whether your old employer's PF has been transferred to your new account under Transfer History.
A pending transfer usually clears in 15 to 30 days once both employers have acted, so track it rather than assuming it is done.

sections.heading: One UAN for Life, Across Every Job
content: You never need a new UAN for a job change. Just tell your new employer your existing UAN, and they add their contributions to the same account.
Your old employer's balance merges automatically once the transfer goes through. If you were wrongly issued two UANs, ask EPFO to merge them.
Activation is always free, so never pay an agent who claims to do it for a fee. The whole process takes about five minutes on your own phone.

sections.title: Activate on Your First Week at a New Job
sections.content:
Do not wait until you need to withdraw PF. Activate your UAN and complete KYC within the first week of joining, so every service is ready when you need it.

Many people discover a broken KYC only when they urgently need money, and then face days of delay. Doing it early avoids that scramble.

sections.heading: EPFO 3.0: UPI and ATM Withdrawals
content: EPFO is rolling out EPFO 3.0 through 2026, which lets members withdraw up to 75% of their balance instantly via UPI apps or a dedicated EPFO ATM card.
Claims up to Rs 5 lakh are now auto-settled without manual verification if your KYC is complete, and most online claims settle in 3 to 5 working days.
All of this needs an activated UAN with seeded Aadhaar, PAN, and bank, which is one more reason to activate and complete KYC early.

sections.title: Never Share Your UAN Password
sections.content:
Your UAN password gives full access to your EPF account, including balance, transfer, and withdrawal. Never share it with HR, payroll, or any PF consultant.

EPFO services are always free. Anyone charging Rs 500 to Rs 1000 to activate your UAN is exploiting you, since you can do it yourself in five minutes.

sections.heading: PF Withdrawal After Activation
content: A full withdrawal using Form 19 is allowed only after you have left a job for 2 months. The full balance reaches your linked bank account in about 10 to 20 days, if KYC is done.
A partial advance using Form 31 is allowed while still employed, for needs like medical, housing, or education. There is no waiting period for genuine emergencies.
Withdrawing before 5 years of continuous service attracts TDS if the balance is above Rs 50,000. Transferring rather than withdrawing keeps your service period unbroken.
Continuous service counts across employers if you transferred your PF rather than withdrawing it, which is what keeps your withdrawal tax-free after 5 years.
This is the strongest reason to transfer and not withdraw when you switch jobs, since restarting the clock can cost you tax later.

sections.text: 6.5 crore active EPF members. Over 50% haven't activated their UAN - meaning they can't check their PF balance, can't transfer PF when switching jobs, and can't file withdrawal claims online. Activation takes 5 minutes at unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in. Those 5 minutes unlock your entire EPF savings - potentially Rs 5-50 lakh accumulated over your career.

sections.heading: UAN for Gig and Contract Workers
content: If you are a contract employee at a company with 20 or more staff, the employer must register you for EPF and give you a UAN. If they deduct PF but give no UAN, demand one in writing.
Gig platform workers like delivery riders are currently classed as partners, not employees, so they are not covered by EPF yet. They should register on e-Shram for basic social security.
Freelancers can open a Voluntary Provident Fund through EPFO and contribute any amount, which qualifies for an 80C deduction.
A Voluntary Provident Fund lets salaried people contribute more than the standard 12%, and it earns the same EPF interest with the same tax treatment.
For freelancers and informal workers, this is a rare way to get a safe, government-backed return without formal employment.

sections.heading: Three Ways to Check Your Balance
content: After activation you have three quick ways to see your PF balance without logging in every time. The fastest is a missed call to 011-22901406 from your registered mobile.
You can also send an SMS in the format EPFOHO UAN ENG to 7738299899, replacing ENG with your preferred language code. The balance arrives by return SMS.
For full detail, the passbook on the member portal or UMANG app shows every monthly contribution, the interest credited, and your running total.

sections.heading: How PF Transfer Works When You Switch Jobs
content: When you join a new company, do not withdraw your old PF. Instead transfer it, so your savings and your pension service stay unbroken.
Log in, open Online Services, and choose One Member One EPF Account. Pick your previous employer's account and submit the transfer request.
Either your old or new employer attests it online, and the balance moves in about 15 to 20 days. With EPFO 3.0, fully verified KYC can let many transfers happen without employer consent.
If a transfer is pending, your new employer should have received the request from your old one. Chase it if it has been more than a month.
Keeping the transfer moving matters because an idle old account stops earning interest after three years of no contributions.

sections.heading: Tax Rules on EPF You Should Know
content: Interest on your own EPF contributions up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year is tax-free. Anything above that threshold earns interest that is taxable.
If you withdraw before completing five years of continuous service and the balance is over Rs 50,000, TDS applies. Linking your PAN keeps that deduction at the lower rate.
A withdrawal after five years of continuous service is fully tax-free, which is another reason to transfer rather than restart with each job.
EPF contributions also qualify for deduction under Section 80C, up to the overall limit, which lowers your taxable income in the year you contribute.
Together with the tax-free interest and tax-free maturity after five years, this makes EPF one of the most tax-efficient savings tools for salaried people.

sections.heading: Why Activate Early, Not at the Last Minute
content: Most people only discover a broken KYC or a name mismatch when they urgently need to withdraw money, and then face days of back-and-forth.
Activating in your first week and finishing KYC means everything is verified and ready well before any emergency.
It also means your balance alerts, passbook, and transfer features all work from day one, so you always know where your retirement money stands.
During emergencies in the past, EPFO allowed special non-refundable advances of up to 75% of the balance, processed quickly for activated accounts.
Having an active UAN with clean KYC is what lets you tap any such provision instantly rather than scrambling to fix records first.

sections.heading: Keep Your Details Updated Over Time
content: Your EPF records are only useful if they stay current. If you change your phone number, update it in your Aadhaar and your EPFO profile so OTP and alerts keep working.
If you change banks, update the bank details in KYC before filing any claim, or the money can bounce back.
A quick yearly check of your passbook and KYC status takes minutes and saves you from nasty surprises when you actually need your PF.

faqs.question: I forgot my UAN password. How to reset without visiting office?
faqs.answer:
Visit unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in → click 'Forgot Password' → Enter your 12-digit UAN → Click 'Send OTP' → OTP sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile → Enter OTP → Set a new password (8+ chars, upper, lower, number, special char) → Done. You can reset password online within 2 minutes.

No office visit needed.

faqs.question: My company says I don't have UAN and won't provide it. What's my recourse?
faqs.answer:
By law under the EPF Act, every employer registered with EPFO must issue UAN to all employees within 10 days of hiring. If your employer is refusing or delaying: (1) Email HR in writing asking for UAN, (2) If ignored, complain to the nearest EPFO office with appointment letter and salary slips as proof.

(3) File a complaint at epfigms.gov.in. EPFO can levy a fine on the employer.

Many startups and small companies ignore this - be firm and escalate.

faqs.question: I have an old employer's UAN from 5 years ago. Can I use it with my new employer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, use the old UAN! When you join a new EPFO company, inform your new HR about your old UAN.

They'll register your employment under the same UAN. Your new employer's contribution will be added to your old balance, creating one consolidated account.

PF is NOT lost - it all merges under one UAN. This is the entire point of the UAN system.

faqs.question: What's the difference between UAN activation and EPFO membership?
faqs.answer:
EPFO membership is created the moment your employer registers your details, and it happens automatically. UAN activation is when you personally log in with your UAN and password to use the services.

Membership is passive and managed by your employer. Activation is active, and only you can do it to check balance, transfer, or withdraw.

faqs.question: Can I activate UAN without Aadhaar?
faqs.answer:
No, Aadhaar is mandatory for UAN activation as of 2024. EPFO requires Aadhaar for verification and OTP-based authentication.

If you don't have Aadhaar, get it first (aadhar.uidai.gov.in or UIDAI center). Process takes 30 minutes.

Once you have Aadhaar linked to your mobile, UAN activation takes 5 minutes.

faqs.question: After activation, can I check my spouse's or child's PF balance using my login?
faqs.answer:
No, each person's UAN is private. Your UAN is only for you.

Your spouse and children have their own UANs (if they're employees under EPFO). Each person must activate and login with their own UAN and password.

EPFO doesn't allow account linking between family members.

faqs.question: I activated UAN but passbook shows zero balance. Is my PF lost?
faqs.answer:
No, PF is not lost. Possible reasons: (1) You recently joined and employer hasn't credited first month's contribution yet.

(2) This is your first UAN activation and old employer's PF hasn't transferred yet. (3) You were in probation and hadn't contributed to EPF yet.

Check 'View Passbook' → see month-wise contributions. If no contributions for months you worked, complain to HR or EPFO.

PF is credited monthly by law.

faqs.question: Can I have two active UANs?
faqs.answer:
No, you should have only one UAN. If you were mistakenly issued two UANs (from two different employers who didn't realize you already had one), contact EPFO to consolidate them.

File a request at nearest EPFO office with proof of both UANs. They'll merge both accounts into one UAN, and you'll get the full balance.

faqs.question: How to check EPF balance without activating UAN?
faqs.answer:
Give a missed call to 011-22901406 from your UAN-registered mobile - balance is sent via SMS (works without portal activation but requires mobile number registered with EPFO). Or send SMS: EPFOHO UAN ENG to 7738299899.

For detailed passbook with monthly breakdown, you need portal activation - the SMS methods show only total balance.

faqs.question: Can I activate UAN without employer?
faqs.answer:
Partial activation is possible using Aadhaar-based OTP. But KYC approval requires employer action from their portal.

If you've left the company and KYC is pending, contact your previous employer's HR to approve pending KYC. If the employer is non-responsive, visit your jurisdictional EPFO office with UAN, Aadhaar, and a written request for manual KYC approval.

faqs.question: What if I forgot my UAN number?
faqs.answer:
Visit unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in → 'Know Your UAN.' Enter any ONE: Member ID (from salary slip), Aadhaar number, or PAN number. The portal displays your UAN.

You can also check your salary slip (UAN is printed on most payslips) or ask your current/previous employer's HR department.

faqs.question: Is UAN same as PF number?
faqs.answer:
No, they are different. Your PF number, the Member ID, changes with every employer, while the UAN is permanent and stays the same across all jobs.

One UAN can hold several PF numbers, one from each employer. The UAN links all of them into a single identity.

faqs.question: Can I activate my UAN without OTP now?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Since August 2025, you can activate your UAN using Aadhaar Face Authentication on the UMANG app, without an OTP.

The OTP-based portal method still works too, so use whichever is easier for you.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw PF through UPI now?
faqs.answer:
Under EPFO 3.0, rolling out through 2026, members can withdraw up to 75% of their balance via UPI or an EPFO ATM card.

This needs an activated UAN with complete KYC, so finish KYC early to use it.

faqs.question: What is the full form of UAN?
faqs.answer:
The full form of UAN is Universal Account Number. It is a 12-digit permanent number that EPFO issues to every EPF member.

It links all your PF accounts across employers and stays the same for life, even when you change jobs.

faqs.question: What is the UAN customer care number?
faqs.answer:
The EPFO toll-free helpline is 1800-118-005, which handles UAN activation and PF claim queries. It is free to call.

For complaints that need tracking, raise a grievance online at epfigms.gov.in instead of calling.

faqs.question: How do I download my UAN card?
faqs.answer:
Log in to the member portal at unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in, then go to View and select UAN Card. You can download it as a PDF.

The UAN card shows your UAN, name, date of birth, and Aadhaar-linked photo, and works as proof of your EPF membership.

disclaimer: This guide is based on EPFO procedures as of March 2026. EPFO processes, portal features, and requirements may change. Always verify current information from epfindia.gov.in or your EPFO office.
